items.zhSummary: IDEXX 发布 Catalyst™ proBNP 检测，是首款也是唯一一款可在诊所内使用、覆盖双物种（犬猫）的即时心脏病评估检测。

items.title: Zoetis cuts annual forecasts as pet healthcare demand slows

items.title: FDA Finalizes Guidance on Evaluating Safety of Antimicrobial Animal Drugs Based on Their Importance in Human Medicine
